reason: The body-centered tetragonal cell, Z=2, and average framework are strongly supported by the line positions and most intensities, but the exact submitted I4/mmm realization is not sufficiently established. No comparable whole-pattern score was supplied; a common-profile fit leaves Rwp about 0.069 and underpredicts the observed 002 peak by nearly a factor of five. The trajectory instantiated only the I4/mmm framework and an origin-equivalent S/Se swap, without testing symmetry-lowered coordinate models. A scientifically motivated I4mm subgroup on the same cell, with only small layer-height shifts and plausible geometry, reduces the integrated-intensity weighted residual by about two-thirds, improves the common-profile Rwp to about 0.067, and accounts for the 002 and other weak-line discrepancies. Therefore a materially different candidate could improve the set and another solution attempt is warranted.
